_readme: The one place for the settings of the refresh pipeline (pull -> bin -> cluster -> splits -> bake-off). The scripts read it; an environment variable of the same purpose overrides it for one run (see each script's header). Changing a value changes the results: record it (the bake-off writes this file's content into its output folder).
_control_note: control = the deployed model: the reference of the Bonferroni-Dunn / Wilcoxon comparisons and of the classical-ML figure (ProtT5: the best embedding on the 2026_03 release, and it needs only sequence)
_annotation_note: Stage 6 needs CLEAN and Horizyn (see EXTERNAL_TOOLS.md). Leave the paths empty: bash workflow/setup_tools.sh --install all installs them under tools/ and records them in refresh_config.local.json (not committed); an environment variable CLEAN_APP_DIR / HORIZYN_DIR overrides
_tools_note: Paths of tools that environment.yml does not install (see EXTERNAL_TOOLS.md and workflow/setup_tools.sh). An environment variable (COLABFOLD_BATCH, CHIMERAX, FOLDSEEK_BIN) overrides them. Empty foldseek_bin: <repo>/tools/foldseek/bin (make tools) or the PATH.
